decisions.statement: A kind is read from a bracketed aside and from the tail after the first dash.
The tail after the first dash runs to the end however many dashes follow.
A word outside an aside and outside that tail names no kind.
A title naming more than one kind takes the first kind this states.
A live take of a remix is a remix, because the remix is what was played.
A medley and a reprise are pieces of their own rather than kinds of recording.
Nothing here reads the release a track sits on.
A deluxe release carrying both studio and live takes is why.

definition: the kind of recording a released title says a track is
